about: Index of the Blender station box models of Canada Water and Canary Wharf (made 2026-10-05 through the blender-mcp MCP server; skill blender-station-models). The models live in danbri/londat; this file says where, in which frame, and which levels were chosen.
licence: The models contain OpenStreetMap-derived geometry (ODbL 1.0, © OpenStreetMap contributors). Layout from the TfL axonometric sheets (RPSI re-use, approved by danbri 2026-10-05 for the scoping phase). This index: facts and URLs.

frame.glb_obj_fbx: Y up: x = E - E0, y = m OD, z = -(N - N0) (the 3D page frame)
frame.blend_usdc_stl: Z up: X = E - E0, Y = N - N0, Z = m OD

contains: screenshots (68, every 5 s, scripted rebuild of 2026-10-05 19:45-19:51 UTC; the 102 10-second captures of the authoring session are in londat commit 0077caa)

level_sources.ticket_hall: judged from the published hall height 10.8 m

canary-wharf.contents: box 313.85 x 35 x 27 m (architect), OSM platforms 174.9 m, OSM hall floors + published hall 222.79 x 32.7 x 10.8 m, mezzanine, ESC 1-20 (OSM positions, sheet numbering), B1 stair, 2 lifts (OSM), stairs C and D (sheet), canopies A, B (OSM footprints) and B1 (judged), 3 entrances, tracks and tunnel stubs

level_sources.jl_rail: TfL FOI-0493-2223 (supersedes Wikipedia 22 m, audit AT-5)
level_sources.ell_platform: Wikipedia 11 m below ground (the 3D page control cw-ell-platform)

canada-water.contents: JL box 150 x 23 x 22 m and ELL slot 130 m x 13 m deep (Wikipedia), OSM JL platforms 135.4 m, ELL platforms 3 and 4 (judged), OSM hall, ELL-level concourse, glass drum 25 m (centre fitted to OSM), 12 escalators (8 OSM + 4 judged middles), 22 OSM stair flights, lifts 1-4 and escape stair 3 (sheet), 5 entrances, tracks and tunnel stubs
